_comment: Lookup table for the Macro & Industry Analyst Agent. `sector_etfs` gives the universal sector ETF (every company gets its sector's ETF performance, via yfinance historical prices). `industry_indicators` gives industry-specific macro indicators pulled from FRED via tools/macro_calculations.py, looked up by yfinance's `.info['industry']` string first, falling back to `sector_default_indicators` keyed by `.info['sector']`, falling back to an empty list (universal macro indicators only) if neither matches.

Banks - Regional.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Banks - Regional.why: Bank net interest margins move with long-term rates

Banks - Diversified.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Banks - Diversified.why: Bank net interest margins move with long-term rates

Insurance - Diversified.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Insurance - Diversified.why: Insurers invest premiums in long-duration bonds

Insurance - Life.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Insurance - Life.why: Life insurer investment income moves with long-term rates

REIT - Diversified.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
REIT - Diversified.why: REIT valuations and borrowing costs are rate-sensitive

REIT - Diversified.name: 30-Year Mortgage Rate
REIT - Diversified.why: Financing costs affect REIT acquisitions and refinancing

REIT - Residential.name: 30-Year Mortgage Rate
REIT - Residential.why: Mortgage rates affect renter demand and refinancing costs

Utilities - Regulated Electric.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Utilities - Regulated Electric.why: Utility stocks trade like bond proxies, sensitive to rates

Utilities - Regulated Gas.name: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price
Utilities - Regulated Gas.why: Direct input cost for gas utilities

Airlines.name: WTI Crude Oil Price
Airlines.why: Jet fuel is airlines' largest variable cost

Oil & Gas Integrated.name: WTI Crude Oil Price
Oil & Gas Integrated.why: Primary revenue driver for oil producers

Oil & Gas E&P.name: WTI Crude Oil Price
Oil & Gas E&P.why: Primary revenue driver for oil producers

Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.name: WTI Crude Oil Price
Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing.why: Input cost for refiners; crack spread driver

Auto Manufacturers.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Auto Manufacturers.why: Auto loan rates track long-term Treasury yields

Financial Services.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Financial Services.why: Financial sector margins broadly track long-term rates

Utilities.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
Utilities.why: Utility stocks trade like bond proxies

Energy.name: WTI Crude Oil Price
Energy.why: Energy sector revenue tracks oil prices broadly
